<DOCSTRING>
Calculates the result of a mathematical operation.

Dispatches to specific handlers based on the operation type (add, subtract, multiply, divide). Validates the input numbers to ensure they are valid numbers before performing the calculation. Logs the operation details for audit and traceability.

@throws {Error} Throws an error if the operation is invalid.

@param {string} operation - The mathematical operation to perform ('add', 'subtract', 'multiply', 'divide').
@param {number} a - The first number for the operation.
@param {number} b - The second number for the operation.

@returns {number} The result of the mathematical operation.
</DOCSTRING>
